items.title: Milt Hinton interviewed by Joe Williams, Majesty of the Seas, May 31, 1995
items.q: But I mean like Bill Berry was in the band, Urbie Green, Gerry Mulligan.

ctx.x: Of course, there are always white people there.
But I mean like Bill Berry was in the band, Urbie Green, Gerry Mulligan.
But I’m not talking about the band, I was talking about the public, Duke Ellington’s friends.
